steps.instruction:

在交接件中加入「Mantevo 代理程式：架構、所有權與資料介面」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：r.4時中心[0,1,0]更新成.2；權重[.4,.2,.4]和為1且非負；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：畫5點網格與固定端點，區分內點更新與邊界強制；新舊陣列分開；.4/.6可重算，接受前者且以明示穩定理由拒絕後者。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:

Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Draw five grid points/fixed endpoints, separating interior updates from boundary enforcement and old/new buffers. Reproduce 0.4/0.6, accept the former and reject the latter using the stated bound. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
